title: Vampire Vape Shortz Cool Red Slush
description: What could be more immediately refreshing that a fruit slushy bursting with luscious strawberries and tangy raspberries? It wouldn’t be a slushy, however, without layers of crushed ice, and this invigorating e-liquid from Vampire Vape carries a delightfully cool undertone to truly enliven the senses. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
